wsgi_script_alias.description: The URL path alias for the WSGI script.

wsgi_script_path.description: The filesystem path to the WSGI script.

web_root_alias.description: The URL path alias for the web root directory.

web_root_dir.description: The filesystem path to the web root directory.

custom_allow_host_ip.description: The IP address of the host to allow access from, uncommented. Leave empty to remain commented out as in default config.
